stories.h: Power nearly restored after weekend windstorm
stories.s: Nearly all power has returned after Saturday's storm knocked out service for 115,000 customers.

stories.h: Three school districts prepare to sue the state
stories.s: Lake Washington, Tacoma and Yakima districts, serving over 74,000 students, plan to sue over basic-education funding.
The initiative barring biologically male students from girls' sports takes effect Dec. 3.
More than 58% of voters rejected repealing the 9.9% tax on incomes over $1 million.
Seattle Public Schools adopted new rules for AI use in classrooms.

talking.s: Drew Lock and AJ Barner scored in the win over the Cardinals; Lock starts Sunday against the Raiders.
